intro: Return to Kristoff concludes Brother Kristoff's search for the elusive tome, The Stresses of Iron. After journeying through Redridge to fetch ore for special ink and waiting on Northshire's scribes, the adventurer finally brings the borrowed volume back to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron. Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find the book?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's the one! Thank you, friend. May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
